commits.message:
feat(strip): one CellJoiner whose shape is data replaces the four joiner classes (rich-joiners-9ntp.mjl)

PowerlineJoiner, CapsuleJoiner, PlainJoiner and GradientJoiner are deleted.
Each is now a JoinShape value given to CellJoiner: POWERLINE_JOINER,
CAPSULE_JOINER, PLAIN_JOINER, gradientJoiner(steps). Every rule of the cell
model is refused at construction.

Behaviour changes:
- The powerline lead is U+E0B0 drawn in reverse video ("ground" as fg), not U+E0D7.
- PLAIN_JOINER draws " | " in the new theme style strip.separator (bright_black), not dim.
- CAPSULE_JOINER ships its rounded glyphs and a space between pills; with fg-only
  neighbours it draws nothing, where it used to draw caps in the default colour.
chore(docs-runner): delete libraryModule, which has no callers (rich-docs-runner-37pe) (#383)
